correctness.rationale: Every pairwise-intersecting family of edges is a star or the three-edge triangle. The face-poset map sends singleton edge to its two labels, star-face to common ground vertex, and exceptional triangle to its three ground vertices; comparable faces map to comparable subsets and subdivided exceptional triangles map by six flags homeomorphically. The star union is homotopy equivalent to the subdivided K_n graph, then gluing the exceptional triangular 2-cells induces a homotopy equivalence to sk_2 Delta^(n−1), equivariant as a map. The augmented simplicial boundary is exterior contraction by epsilon on wedge³Z^n, with kernel wedge³ ker epsilon, exactly integrally. Decomposing the rational augmentation module under H=product S_{m_i} gives (r−1) trivial directions and within-block standards, yielding invariant third exterior dimension C(r−1,3). Verified independent face classification and map comparability for n4..7. Importantly quotient statement is rational only; no false equivariant homotopy inverse claimed.
residual_risks: The universal homotopy map relies on a gluing argument; finite tests alone cover n<=7.
